_note: Predictive Sandbox R&D content. Family: aftermath. Texture: the dust settling, cleanup, managing consequences, or dealing with residue. Routes heavily on pass_state and lifecycle_route=residual.

entries.title: The Ambient Echo of an Event
entries.body: The active crisis or event is completely over, but its footprint remains in the environment. This is a low-level background frequency. Decisions are still colored by what happened, but the actual mechanics of the event have shut down.
entries.notes: pass_state == RESIDUAL_FIELD: the lingering energetic tail.

entries.title: A Difficult Sort-Out
entries.body: The exact threshold has been crossed, and the window is now strictly in the aftermath phase. However, the signals remain frictional. The event is over, but the cleanup is messy, contested, or logistically frustrating. The pieces don't want to sweep up easily.

entries.title: Building From the Residue
entries.body: The event has passed, and the immediate focus is constructing something new from what remains. The operation is highly productive, indicating that the aftermath is being treated as a foundation rather than just a mess to clear away.

entries.title: The Final Settling of Accounts
entries.body: The aftermath itself is formalizing into a close. The gradient is releasing and the state is resolved. This marks the true end of the cycle—the final paperwork is filed, the last piece of residue is processed, and the system is ready to drop the issue entirely.
entries.notes: RESOLUTION + releasing: the end of the aftermath.
